summary: Summarized Pi SDK changes between 0.84.2 and 0.84.4, then upgraded the @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent dependency from 0.84.2 to 0.84.4 in apps/agent-server and packages/extensions, rebased the custom fullTurnBoundaries compaction patch onto 0.84.4, deleted the obsolete 0.84.2 patch, and verified the upgrade with pnpm install, format:check, check, test (64 files / 308 tests passing), and build.
decisions: Upgrade @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent from 0.84.2 to 0.84.4 rather than skipping to a later version, to capture PowerShell tool, compaction, session-integrity, and Windows fixes discussed in the changelog review.
Rebase the existing pnpm patch (adding fullTurnBoundaries and custom compaction budgeting) onto the 0.84.4 dist files instead of dropping it, preserving Gizmo's compaction behavior.
Delete patches/@earendil-works__pi-coding-agent@0.84.2.patch since pnpm-workspace.yaml no longer references 0.84.2.
Treat GoogleThinkingLevel → GoogleApiThinkingLevel as a non-issue after grepping the codebase (no matches) and proceed with the upgrade.
